column1: The CNX Nifty Junior closed at 6043.15 points on September 30, 2008 representing a decrease of 1095.15 points (-15.34%) as compared to 7138.3 points on August 29, 2008 . During the month of September 2008, the CNX Nifty Junior touched a high of 7400.25 points on September 02, 2008 before closing at 6043.15 points on September 30, 2008. The market capitalisation of CNX Nifty Junior decreased from Rs 434157 crores in August 29, 2008 to Rs 385721 crores in September 30, 2008 i.e. a decrease of  Rs.48436 crores(-11.16%)
* Beta & R2 are calculated for the period  01-October-2007 to 30-September-2008
* Beta measures the  degree to which any portfolio of stocks is affected as compared to the effect on the market as a whole.
* The coefficient of determination (R2) measures the strength of relationship between two variables,
the return on  a security versus that of the market.
* Volatility is the Std. deviation of the daily returns for the period 01-September-2008 to 30-September-2008
* Impact Cost for CNX Nifty Junior is for a portfolio of Rs. 25 lakhs
* Impact Cost for CNX Nifty Junior is the weightage average impact cost
